AIR CONDITIONING SYSTEM – TROUBLESHOOTING

7 Check magnetic clutch relay.

P Remove magnetic clutch relay from R/B No. 2.

C Check continuity between each pair of terminals shown below of magnetic clutch relay.

OK Terminals 1 and 2    Approx. 75 Ω
   Terminals 3 and 5    No continuity

P 1. Apply battery positive voltage between terminals 1 and 2.
   2. Check continuity between terminals 3 and 5.

OK Terminals 3 and 5    Continuity

N08833

OK

NG Replace magnetic relay.
